owaspDescriptions.ASI01: Agent Goal Hijack: Manipulating agent goals via prompt injection, deceptive inputs, or poisoned data
owaspDescriptions.ASI02: Tool Misuse & Exploitation: Agents misusing legitimate tools through over-privileged access or unsafe delegation
owaspDescriptions.ASI03: Identity & Privilege Abuse: Exploiting delegation chains, credential inheritance, and privilege escalation in agents
owaspDescriptions.ASI04: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities: Compromised MCP tools, poisoned dependencies, and typosquatted agent components
owaspDescriptions.ASI05: Unexpected Code Execution (RCE): Shell injection, code hallucination, unsafe eval(), and sandbox escape via agents
owaspDescriptions.ASI06: Memory & Context Poisoning: RAG poisoning, shared context corruption, and long-term memory drift
owaspDescriptions.ASI07: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication: MITM on agent messages, protocol spoofing, and A2A registration attacks
owaspDescriptions.ASI08: Cascading Failures: Single faults propagating and amplifying across interconnected agents and workflows
owaspDescriptions.ASI09: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation: Social engineering via agent authority, fake explainability, and automation bias
owaspDescriptions.ASI10: Rogue Agents: Behavioral drift, goal deviation, self-replication, and emergent misalignment

hooks.name: Session Start
hooks.description: Triggered when an agent session begins. Initialize audit trails, set environment variables, inject mandatory security context.
hooks.securityValue: Establish security context and audit logging from the first interaction. Inject mandatory security instructions and environment variables.

hooks.name: Session End
hooks.description: Triggered when an agent session terminates. Finalize logs, send telemetry, clean up resources.
hooks.securityValue: Ensure complete audit trail closure. Detect abnormal session terminations and exfiltration attempts.

hooks.name: Stop / Agent Complete
hooks.description: Triggered when the agent finishes responding. Can block the agent from stopping to enforce task completion quality gates.
hooks.securityValue: Verify agent completed within expected bounds. Trigger post-session security scans. Enforce quality gates before work is accepted.

hooks.name: Before Shell Execution
hooks.description: Triggered before a command is executed in the terminal. Inspect, modify, or block the command before it runs. Also mitigates ASI05 (Unexpected Code Execution).
hooks.securityValue: Prevents unauthorized destructive commands (rm -rf), credential exfiltration (curl with secrets), or privilege escalation.

hooks.name: After Shell Execution
hooks.description: Triggered after a shell command completes. Inspect output for sensitive data leakage or unexpected behavior.
hooks.securityValue: Detect secrets in command output, flag unexpected exit codes, audit all terminal activity for forensics.

hooks.name: Before File Read
hooks.description: Triggered before reading a file. Control which files the agent can access based on path, extension, or content.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent reading sensitive files (.env, credentials, private keys). Enforce least-privilege file access policies.

hooks.name: After File Edit
hooks.description: Triggered after a file has been modified. Run formatters, linters, or security scanners on the changes.
hooks.securityValue: Scan for injected backdoors, hardcoded secrets, or malicious code patterns in edits. Auto-run linters.

hooks.name: Tab File Read
hooks.description: Triggered before inline completion (Tab) reads a file. Separate policy for autonomous completions.
hooks.securityValue: Restrict Tab's file access independently from Agent mode. Prevent autocomplete from reading secrets.

hooks.name: Tab File Edit
hooks.description: Triggered after Tab applies an inline edit. Post-process and scan autonomous completions.
hooks.securityValue: Scan inline completions for injected vulnerabilities or backdoors before they enter the codebase.

hooks.name: Pre Tool Use
hooks.description: Triggered before any tool call. Universal policy gate for all tool operations: shell, file, MCP, and more.
hooks.securityValue: Universal policy gate. Block any tool call based on runtime context, rate limits, or security policies. Can modify tool input.

hooks.name: Post Tool Use
hooks.description: Triggered after any tool call succeeds. Audit and inspect tool outputs for sensitive data or anomalies.
hooks.securityValue: Complete audit trail of all tool operations. Detect anomalous tool behavior patterns. Can modify MCP tool output.

hooks.name: Post Tool Use Failure
hooks.description: Triggered when a tool call fails, times out, or is denied. Track failures for anomaly detection.
hooks.securityValue: Detect brute-force attempts, repeated failures indicating adversarial probing or permission boundary testing.

hooks.name: Permission Request
hooks.description: Triggered when a permission dialog appears. Programmatically approve, deny, or modify permission requests based on policy.
hooks.securityValue: Automate permission decisions based on policy. Prevent permission fatigue from leading to over-permissioning. Can update permission rules.

hooks.name: Before MCP Execution
hooks.description: Triggered before an MCP tool is called. Gate external tool access and validate arguments before execution.
hooks.securityValue: Control which external tools/services the agent can invoke. Prevent unauthorized API calls or data exfiltration via MCP.

hooks.name: After MCP Execution
hooks.description: Triggered after an MCP tool completes. Inspect and sanitize results for sensitive data before returning to the agent.
hooks.securityValue: Audit external tool responses. Detect and redact sensitive information returned by MCP servers.

hooks.name: MCP Elicitation
hooks.description: Triggered when an MCP server requests user input. Respond programmatically or deny the elicitation based on policy.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent MCP servers from social-engineering users via elicitation prompts. Automate or block input requests.

hooks.name: MCP Elicitation Result
hooks.description: Triggered after user responds to an MCP elicitation. Modify or block the response before it reaches the MCP server.
hooks.securityValue: Sanitize user responses before sending to MCP servers. Prevent accidental disclosure of credentials or sensitive data.

hooks.name: Before Prompt Submit
hooks.description: Triggered before a prompt is sent to the LLM. Validate, modify, or block prompts based on content policy.
hooks.securityValue: Detect prompt injection attempts, enforce content policies, redact sensitive data from prompts before they reach the model.

hooks.name: Subagent Start
hooks.description: Triggered when a subagent (Task tool) is spawned. Control subagent creation and enforce permission boundaries.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent unauthorized subagent spawning. Enforce resource limits, model restrictions, and permission boundaries for subagents.

hooks.name: Subagent Stop
hooks.description: Triggered when a subagent finishes. Audit subagent activity, review scope, and optionally block completion.
hooks.securityValue: Review subagent actions post-execution. Detect scope creep, unauthorized operations, or modified files outside boundaries.
hooks.payload: { agent_id?, agent_type, status, summary?, duration_ms, last_assistant_message? }

hooks.name: Teammate Idle
hooks.description: Triggered before a teammate agent goes idle. Prevent idle state or stop the agent entirely based on workload policy.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent agents from sitting idle when security-critical tasks remain. Enforce task completion SLAs.

hooks.name: Task Completed
hooks.description: Triggered when a task is marked complete. Enforce quality gates: run tests, linters, or security checks before accepting.
hooks.securityValue: Quality gate enforcement. Block task completion until tests pass, security scans clear, or code review requirements are met.

hooks.name: Pre Compact
hooks.description: Triggered before context window compaction. Observe what data is about to be pruned from the conversation.
hooks.securityValue: Ensure security-critical context (policies, rules) survives compaction. Log compaction events for forensics.

hooks.name: Post Compact
hooks.description: Triggered after context window compaction completes. Verify compaction preserved critical security context.
hooks.securityValue: Audit what was preserved vs. pruned during compaction. Detect if security instructions were lost.

hooks.name: Instructions Loaded
hooks.description: Triggered when instruction files (CLAUDE.md, rules) are loaded into context. Verify instruction integrity.
hooks.securityValue: Detect unauthorized modifications to agent instructions. Verify instruction file integrity and provenance.

hooks.name: Worktree Create
hooks.description: Triggered when a git worktree is created for isolated agent work. Override with custom VCS behavior.
hooks.securityValue: Control isolated execution environments. Replace git with custom VCS. Enforce branch naming and isolation policies.

hooks.name: Worktree Remove
hooks.description: Triggered when a git worktree is removed after agent work completes. Perform cleanup and audit.
hooks.securityValue: Audit worktree contents before cleanup. Detect if sensitive files were created in isolated environments.

hooks.name: Notification
hooks.description: Triggered when the agent sends a notification. Forward security-critical notifications to incident response channels.
hooks.securityValue: Route security-critical notifications to incident response channels. Filter noise from actionable alerts.

hooks.name: Config Change
hooks.description: Triggered when configuration files change during a session. Detect and optionally block runtime configuration tampering.
hooks.securityValue: Detect runtime configuration tampering. Alert on unexpected settings modifications. Block unauthorized config changes.

hooks.name: After Agent Response
hooks.description: Triggered after the agent produces a response. Inspect agent outputs for sensitive data or harmful content.
hooks.securityValue: Scan agent responses for sensitive data leakage, hallucinated credentials, or harmful content before display.

hooks.name: After Agent Thought
hooks.description: Triggered after the agent produces a thinking block. Monitor reasoning chains for anomalous patterns.
hooks.securityValue: Audit agent reasoning for signs of prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, or adversarial thinking patterns.

hooks.name: Before Agent Callback
hooks.description: Executes before the agent's main processing begins. Can skip agent logic entirely by returning a Content response.
hooks.securityValue: Gate agent execution based on policy. Inject security context or block the agent from processing entirely.

hooks.name: After Agent Callback
hooks.description: Executes after agent processing completes, before returning results. Can replace the agent's response.
hooks.securityValue: Audit agent output. Redact sensitive information or override unsafe responses before they reach the user.

hooks.name: Before Model Callback
hooks.description: Executes before LLM requests are sent. Can skip the LLM call entirely by returning a synthetic LlmResponse.
hooks.securityValue: Validate prompts before they reach the model. Enforce content policies, cache responses, or block sensitive requests.

hooks.name: After Model Callback
hooks.description: Executes after LLM responses arrive. Can replace the model's response before it reaches the agent.
hooks.securityValue: Scan model output for harmful content, hallucinated credentials, or prompt injection artifacts before the agent acts on them.

hooks.name: Before Tool Callback
hooks.description: Executes before tool/function execution. Can skip tool execution by returning a result dict directly.
hooks.securityValue: Universal tool-use policy gate. Block dangerous tool calls, validate arguments, or return cached results.

hooks.name: After Tool Callback
hooks.description: Executes after tool execution completes. Can replace the tool's result before it reaches the agent.
hooks.securityValue: Audit tool outputs. Redact sensitive data returned by tools or flag anomalous results.

hooks.name: Codeium Ignore
hooks.description: File-level access control via .codeiumignore. Prevents Cascade from viewing, editing, or creating files in designated paths.
hooks.securityValue: Enforce file access boundaries. Prevent the agent from reading secrets, credentials, or sensitive configuration files.

hooks.name: Windsurf Action Approval
hooks.description: User must press Accept before Cascade applies file edits, runs terminal commands, or installs packages. UI-level gate.
hooks.securityValue: Human-in-the-loop approval for all agent actions. Prevents unauthorized modifications without explicit user consent.

hooks.name: Content Exclusions
hooks.description: Organization-level file path patterns that Copilot will not read or use as context. Configured by admins at org or repo level.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent Copilot from accessing sensitive files (.env, credentials, internal configs). Admin-enforced file-level read restrictions.

hooks.name: Copilot Organization Policies
hooks.description: Admin-level feature toggles controlling Copilot capabilities: code completion, chat, CLI, agent mode, MCP servers, third-party agents.
hooks.securityValue: Coarse-grained policy control. Disable entire feature sets (e.g., agent mode) at organization or enterprise level.

hooks.name: Copilot Agent Mode Approval
hooks.description: In VS Code agent mode, Copilot requires user confirmation before running terminal commands or MCP tool calls.
hooks.securityValue: Human-in-the-loop gate for agentic actions. Users can set individual tools to always-allow or require approval each time.

hooks.name: IAM Action Policies
hooks.description: Fine-grained IAM policies controlling 40+ individual Amazon Q actions: StartAgentSession, GenerateRecommendations, PassRequest, and more.
hooks.securityValue: Granular server-side access control. Deny specific capabilities (e.g., block agentic coding sessions, restrict API passthrough).

hooks.name: Q PassRequest Conditions
hooks.description: IAM conditions on q:PassRequest controlling which AWS APIs Amazon Q can call on the user's behalf. Can restrict by action, region, or service.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent the agent from invoking dangerous AWS operations (e.g., deny ec2:TerminateInstances, s3:DeleteBucket).

hooks.name: Cline Action Approval
hooks.description: Human-in-the-loop approval required for every file change and terminal command. Users review diffs before acceptance.
hooks.securityValue: Complete human oversight of all agent actions. Every file edit shows a diff view, every command requires explicit approval.

hooks.name: Aider Auto-Lint
hooks.description: Automatically runs a configurable lint command after every file edit. If lint fails, Aider shows errors to the LLM for correction.
hooks.securityValue: Post-edit validation gate. Catches code quality issues, potential vulnerabilities, and style violations immediately after agent edits.

hooks.name: Aider Auto-Test
hooks.description: Runs a configurable test command after edits. Failed tests trigger a correction loop where Aider attempts to fix the issues.
hooks.securityValue: Automated regression detection. Ensures agent changes don't break existing functionality or introduce security regressions.

hooks.name: Aider Read-Only Files
hooks.description: Mark files as read-only context via --read flag. Aider can see these files for context but cannot modify them.
hooks.securityValue: File-level write protection. Prevent the agent from modifying critical configuration, infrastructure, or security-sensitive files.

hooks.name: Aider Git Commit Verify
hooks.description: When enabled, enforces git pre-commit hooks on agent-generated commits via --git-commit-verify flag.
hooks.securityValue: Leverage existing git pre-commit hooks (secret scanners, linters, formatters) to validate agent-generated code before it's committed.

hooks.name: Tool Run Confirmation
hooks.description: Ask the end user for confirmation before running a tool. Configurable per-tool in the agent's tool settings.
hooks.securityValue: Human-in-the-loop gate for individual tool executions. Prevents unauthorized actions without explicit user consent.

hooks.name: Tool Enable/Disable
hooks.description: Enable or disable individual tools per agent. Disabled tools remain connected but cannot be invoked by the agent.
hooks.securityValue: Granular tool-level access control. Restrict which tools an agent can use without removing the integration entirely.

hooks.name: Tool Authentication Gate
hooks.description: Tools require authentication before execution. Configurable per-tool: end user credentials or maker-provided credentials.
hooks.securityValue: Enforce identity-aware tool execution. Ensure users only access data they're authorized to see through agent tools.

hooks.name: Generative Orchestration Control
hooks.description: Toggle between generative orchestration (agent auto-selects tools/topics) and classic mode (explicit topic-only routing).
hooks.securityValue: Control agent autonomy level. Classic mode restricts agent to predefined conversation paths, preventing unexpected tool selection.

hooks.name: DLP Policies
hooks.description: Data Loss Prevention policies via Power Platform. Control which connectors and data flows the agent can access at the environment level.
hooks.securityValue: Enterprise-grade data governance. Prevent agents from accessing or transferring data across restricted boundaries.

hooks.name: Safety Filters
hooks.description: Per-request configurable safety filters across 4 harm categories: harassment, hate speech, sexually explicit, and dangerous content. Adjustable thresholds.
hooks.securityValue: Content-level safety gate. Block harmful inputs or outputs at configurable sensitivity levels (BLOCK_NONE to BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE).

hooks.name: Prompt Feedback
hooks.description: API returns promptFeedback.blockReason when prompts are blocked, and Candidate.finishReason=SAFETY when responses are filtered.
hooks.securityValue: Programmatic detection of blocked content. Enables automated handling of safety filter triggers in agent pipelines.

hooks.name: LangChain Callbacks
hooks.description: BaseCallbackHandler with event hooks: on_llm_start, on_llm_end, on_tool_start, on_tool_end, on_chain_start, on_chain_end, on_agent_action, and error variants.
hooks.securityValue: Comprehensive observability for agent pipelines. Log, audit, and monitor every LLM call, tool invocation, and chain execution.

hooks.name: LangChain Tool Wrappers
hooks.description: Custom tool definitions with input validation via Pydantic schemas. Tools can enforce argument types and constraints before execution.
hooks.securityValue: Input validation at the tool boundary. Prevent malformed or malicious arguments from reaching tool implementations.

hooks.name: CrewAI Task Guardrails
hooks.description: Validation functions that run after task completion. Can reject output and trigger retry loops with feedback to the agent.
hooks.securityValue: Output quality gates. Validate agent task results against criteria before accepting them into the workflow.

hooks.name: CrewAI Human Input
hooks.description: Configure agents or tasks to require human input before proceeding. Enables human-in-the-loop at specific workflow stages.
hooks.securityValue: Human oversight injection points in multi-agent workflows. Require approval for critical decisions or sensitive operations.

hooks.name: Open Interpreter Auto-Run
hooks.description: Controls whether code executes automatically or requires user confirmation. Default is off: every code block requires explicit approval.
hooks.securityValue: Fundamental execution gate. When auto_run is disabled, no code executes without human review and approval.

hooks.name: Open Interpreter Safe Mode
hooks.description: Restricts code execution capabilities. Disables shell access and limits to a safe subset of operations.
hooks.securityValue: Sandboxed execution environment. Prevent the agent from running destructive system commands or accessing sensitive resources.

hooks.name: NeMo Input Rails
hooks.description: rails.input.flows: Colang flows triggered on every user message before reaching the LLM. Built-ins: 'self check input', 'jailbreak detection heuristics', 'mask sensitive data on input', 'content safety check input'.
hooks.securityValue: Block prompt injection and jailbreak attempts; mask PII before the LLM sees user input.

hooks.name: NeMo Output Rails
hooks.description: rails.output.flows: Colang flows triggered after the LLM responds, before the message is returned. Built-ins: 'self check output', 'self check facts', 'self check hallucination', 'content safety check output'.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent harmful, hallucinated, or sensitive content from reaching users. Enforce content policy and factual grounding.

hooks.name: NeMo Dialog Rails
hooks.description: Operate on canonical-form intents (e.g. 'user ask about politics'). Configured via the rails.dialog block in config.yml and defined through Colang flows that constrain conversation to predefined paths.
hooks.securityValue: Restrict agent behavior to allowed topics; block social-engineering attempts and out-of-scope conversations at the intent layer.

hooks.name: NeMo Retrieval Rails
hooks.description: rails.retrieval.flows: Run on RAG-retrieved chunks before they are used to prompt the LLM. Built-in: 'check retrieval sensitive data'.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent poisoned or sensitive retrieved documents from influencing LLM responses; mask PII in retrieved context.

hooks.name: NeMo Tool-Input / Tool-Output Rails
hooks.description: rails.tool_input.flows and rails.tool_output.flows: validate tool/action arguments before invocation and results after, per the NeMo Guardrails configuration reference.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent unauthorized tool invocations and validate tool outputs before they re-enter the LLM context.

hooks.name: NeMo IntermediateStep Stream
hooks.description: IntermediateStepManager publishes workflow events (function boundaries, LLM calls, tool usage) to subscribed telemetry exporters via a reactive stream.
hooks.securityValue: Real-time observability for anomaly detection, usage auditing, and compliance monitoring across multi-framework agent workflows.
hooks.payload: { event_type, timestamp, data: { tokens_used?, time_elapsed?, inputs?, outputs? } }

hooks.name: NeMo Profiler Decorators
hooks.description: nat.plugins.profiler.decorators: wrap workflow and LLM-framework context managers to inject usage-collection callbacks across LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Google ADK.
hooks.securityValue: Framework-agnostic usage monitoring across multi-framework agent workflows for billing oversight and abuse detection.

hooks.name: InterventionHandler.on_send
hooks.description: Called when a message is submitted to the runtime via AgentRuntime.send_message (direct agent-to-agent). Return DropMessage to abort delivery.
hooks.securityValue: Intercept and validate all direct messages between agents; block unauthorized inter-agent communication.
hooks.payload: { message: Any, message_context: MessageContext, recipient: AgentId } -> Any | type[DropMessage]

hooks.name: InterventionHandler.on_publish
hooks.description: Called when a message is published via AgentRuntime.publish_message (broadcast to topic subscribers). Return DropMessage to drop the broadcast.
hooks.securityValue: Gate broadcast messages to prevent a compromised agent from flooding or poisoning all topic subscribers.
hooks.payload: { message: Any, message_context: MessageContext } -> Any | type[DropMessage]

hooks.name: InterventionHandler.on_response
hooks.description: Called when a response is received by the runtime from an agent's message handler. Return DropMessage to suppress the response.
hooks.securityValue: Validate agent responses before they reach the requester; sanitize outputs and filter sensitive data.
hooks.payload: { message: Any, sender: AgentId, recipient: AgentId | None } -> Any | type[DropMessage]

hooks.name: AutoGen Tool-Use Intervention
hooks.description: Cookbook pattern: InterventionHandler checks on_send for FunctionCall message type and prompts for human approval before tool execution.
hooks.securityValue: Human-in-the-loop approval for dangerous tool calls; prevents autonomous execution of destructive operations.
hooks.payload: { message: FunctionCall { name, arguments }, message_context, recipient }

hooks.name: LangGraph interrupt_before
hooks.description: Static breakpoint configured at graph compile time: graph.compile(checkpointer=..., interrupt_before=['node']). Halts before the named node(s) execute.
hooks.securityValue: Mandatory human review before critical nodes (tool calls, external API writes): prevents autonomous execution of high-risk operations.

hooks.name: LangGraph interrupt_after
hooks.description: Static breakpoint: graph.compile(checkpointer=..., interrupt_after=['node']). Halts after the node finishes, before downstream nodes run.
hooks.securityValue: Post-execution audit gate: inspect node outputs (e.g. LLM-generated tool calls) before they propagate.

hooks.name: LangGraph interrupt()
hooks.description: Dynamic breakpoint from inside a node: interrupt(value) raises GraphInterrupt and surfaces value to the caller. Multiple interrupts per node are matched by order. Recommended approach for dynamic breakpoints (available since LangGraph 0.2.x).
hooks.securityValue: Conditional human approval gates: only pause when a tool targets a production resource, or when model confidence is low.
hooks.payload: { value: Any }: resume via Command(resume=<value>): requires checkpointer

hooks.name: LLMChatStartEvent
hooks.description: BaseEventHandler.handle() with LLMChatStartEvent. Fires when an LLM chat call begins; exposes outgoing messages.
hooks.securityValue: Audit all LLM prompts in real time for injection attempts, sensitive data leakage, or policy violations.
hooks.payload: { messages: list[ChatMessage], additional_kwargs: dict, model_dict: dict }

hooks.name: AgentToolCallEvent
hooks.description: BaseEventHandler.handle() with AgentToolCallEvent. Fires when an agent invokes a tool; exposes tool metadata and arguments.
hooks.securityValue: Monitor tool invocations for unauthorized usage patterns, argument anomalies, or policy violations.
hooks.payload: { arguments: str, tool: ToolMetadata { name, description, fn_schema } }

hooks.name: EmbeddingStartEvent
hooks.description: BaseEventHandler.handle() with EmbeddingStartEvent. Fires when an embedding operation begins.
hooks.securityValue: Audit what is being embedded into vector stores to detect data exfiltration or poisoning of retrieval indices.

hooks.name: Retrieval Start/End Event
hooks.description: BaseEventHandler.handle() with RetrievalStartEvent / RetrievalEndEvent. Fires at the start and end of retrieval operations.
hooks.securityValue: Detect context-poisoning sources and audit which documents influence LLM responses.

hooks.name: AgentRunStepStartEvent
hooks.description: BaseEventHandler.handle() with AgentRunStepStartEvent. Fires when an agent begins a new reasoning step.
hooks.securityValue: Track reasoning steps to detect runaway loops, excessive agency, or deviation from expected behavior.
hooks.payload: { task_id: str, step: Any, input: str }

hooks.name: BaseSpanHandler (LlamaIndex)
hooks.description: Subclass BaseSpanHandler[T]; implement new_span / prepare_to_exit_span / prepare_to_drop_span. Span lifecycle for distributed tracing.
hooks.securityValue: Build complete execution traces for forensic analysis; detect abnormal span durations indicating abuse or stalled tools.

hooks.name: Function Invocation Filter
hooks.description: IFunctionInvocationFilter.OnFunctionInvocationAsync (.NET) / @kernel.filter(FilterTypes.FUNCTION_INVOCATION) (Python). Wraps every KernelFunction call; skip next(context) to block.
hooks.securityValue: Universal gate on all kernel function calls: input validation, output sanitization, rate limiting, access control.
hooks.payload: FunctionInvocationContext { function, kernel, arguments, result, is_streaming }

hooks.name: Prompt Render Filter
hooks.description: IPromptRenderFilter.OnPromptRenderAsync / FilterTypes.PROMPT_RENDERING. Triggered when a prompt-based function renders its template before LLM submission.
hooks.securityValue: Inspect/modify rendered prompts; detect injection attempts; enforce templates; redact secrets before they leave the app.

hooks.name: Auto Function Invocation Filter
hooks.description: IAutoFunctionInvocationFilter.OnAutoFunctionInvocationAsync / FilterTypes.AUTO_FUNCTION_INVOCATION. Fires inside the LLM auto-function-calling loop; set context.Terminate=true to stop the whole loop.
hooks.securityValue: Control runaway tool-call chains; enforce per-turn call limits; terminate auto-invocation when policy is violated.
hooks.payload: AutoFunctionInvocationContext { function, arguments, chat_history, request_sequence_index, function_sequence_index, function_count, terminate }

hooks.name: on_agent_start (OpenAI Agents)
hooks.description: RunHooks.on_agent_start: fires before an agent is invoked within a run. Observational; cannot block.
hooks.securityValue: Audit which agent identity handles which task; detect anomalous agent invocation patterns.
hooks.payload: async on_agent_start(context: AgentHookContext, agent: TAgent) -> None

hooks.name: on_agent_end (OpenAI Agents)
hooks.description: RunHooks.on_agent_end: fires when an agent produces its final output within a run.
hooks.securityValue: Inspect final agent output; detect exfiltration or policy violations in completed responses.
hooks.payload: async on_agent_end(context, agent, output: Any) -> None

hooks.name: on_handoff (OpenAI Agents)
hooks.description: RunHooks.on_handoff: fires when one agent delegates control to another agent.
hooks.securityValue: Monitor inter-agent delegation chains; detect unauthorized privilege escalation or rogue handoffs.

hooks.name: on_tool_start (OpenAI Agents)
hooks.description: RunHooks.on_tool_start: fires immediately before a function tool is invoked.
hooks.securityValue: Audit every tool invocation with full parameters for forensic logging.
hooks.payload: async on_tool_start(context, agent, tool: Tool) -> None

hooks.name: on_tool_end (OpenAI Agents)
hooks.description: RunHooks.on_tool_end: fires immediately after a function tool returns.
hooks.securityValue: Inspect tool outputs for data exfiltration before the model consumes them.
hooks.payload: async on_tool_end(context, agent, tool, result: str) -> None

hooks.name: on_llm_start (OpenAI Agents)
hooks.description: RunHooks.on_llm_start: fires just before LLM invocation with system prompt and input items.
hooks.securityValue: Inspect the full outgoing prompt; detect prompt injection embedded in input items.
hooks.payload: async on_llm_start(context, agent, system_prompt: str|None, input_items: list) -> None

hooks.name: on_llm_end (OpenAI Agents)
hooks.description: RunHooks.on_llm_end: fires immediately after the LLM call returns with the raw model response.
hooks.securityValue: Inspect raw model output before tool calls are parsed; detect goal-hijacking outputs.
hooks.payload: async on_llm_end(context, agent, response: ModelResponse) -> None

hooks.name: InputGuardrail
hooks.description: @input_guardrail decorator; raises InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered when tripwire_triggered=True. Attach via Agent(input_guardrails=[...]).
hooks.securityValue: Block off-topic, malicious, or policy-violating inputs from reaching the agent. Set run_in_parallel=False to prevent any token consumption.

hooks.name: OutputGuardrail
hooks.description: @output_guardrail decorator; raises OutputGuardrailTripwireTriggered when policy is violated. Attach via Agent(output_guardrails=[...]).
hooks.securityValue: Block policy-violating, harmful, or data-leaking responses from being returned to the caller.

hooks.name: tool_input_guardrail
hooks.description: @tool_input_guardrail decorator on @function_tool: per-tool validator that runs before execute. ToolGuardrailFunctionOutput supports allow() / reject_content(msg) / raise_exception().
hooks.securityValue: Block dangerous parameters at the tool boundary (e.g. block rm -rf reaching a shell tool) with tool-scoped precision.

hooks.name: tool_output_guardrail
hooks.description: @tool_output_guardrail decorator: per-tool validator that runs after execute. Can replace or block the result.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent sensitive tool outputs (credentials, PII) from being fed back into the model's context.

hooks.name: BeforeInvocationEvent
hooks.description: Fires at the start of an agent invocation. Set event.cancel=True to abort.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent the agent from processing requests based on runtime checks (rate limits, auth state, policy).

hooks.name: AfterInvocationEvent
hooks.description: Fires after an agent invocation completes (success or failure). Use event.resume to trigger a follow-up invocation.
hooks.securityValue: Inspect final invocation state; trigger remediation flows via resume if violations are detected.

hooks.name: BeforeModelCallEvent
hooks.description: Fires before model inference. Exposes event.cancel and event.projected_input_tokens.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent model calls that exceed token budgets or violate policies; detect context-stuffing attempts.
hooks.payload: { invocation_state, projected_input_tokens: int, cancel: string | boolean }

hooks.name: AfterModelCallEvent
hooks.description: Fires after model inference completes. event.retry triggers re-running the model call; event.exception present on failure.
hooks.securityValue: Trigger model re-runs when responses fail safety checks; inspect raw responses before tool-call parsing.
hooks.payload: { invocation_state, stop_response: ModelStopResponse?, exception?, retry_model: bool }

hooks.name: BeforeToolCallEvent
hooks.description: Fires before a tool is invoked. event.selected_tool is mutable (swap tools at runtime); event.tool_use parameters are rewritable; setting event.cancel_tool = true (or a cancellation message string) prevents execution.
hooks.securityValue: Block dangerous tool calls, swap to a safer alternative, or rewrite malicious parameters: the most powerful security hook in Strands.
hooks.payload: { selected_tool: Tool, tool_use: ToolUse, invocation_state, cancel_tool: string | boolean }

hooks.name: AfterToolCallEvent
hooks.description: Fires after tool invocation completes. event.result is mutable (scrub sensitive data); event.retry re-runs the tool.
hooks.securityValue: Scrub sensitive data from tool results before the model consumes them; detect and modify exfiltration payloads.
hooks.payload: { selected_tool, tool_use, result: ToolResultBlock (mutable), retry: bool }

hooks.name: MessageAddedEvent
hooks.description: Fires every time a message is appended to the conversation history.
hooks.securityValue: Detect context-poisoning attempts; monitor for prompt injection in tool results or system messages.

hooks.name: BeforeNodeCallEvent
hooks.description: Fires before a node executes in a multi-agent orchestration graph. Set event.cancel_node = true (or a cancellation message string) to block execution.
hooks.securityValue: Block specific nodes in a multi-agent pipeline based on trust level or policy.
hooks.payload: { orchestrator, node_id, invocation_state, cancel_node: string | boolean }

hooks.name: MultiAgentHandoffEvent
hooks.description: Fires when execution transitions between nodes in a multi-agent orchestration.
hooks.securityValue: Audit agent handoffs; detect unauthorized delegation or unexpected routing.

hooks.name: Bedrock Content Filters
hooks.description: contentPolicyConfig: filters across 6 categories (HATE, INSULTS, SEXUAL, VIOLENCE, MISCONDUCT, PROMPT_ATTACK) at NONE|LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH thresholds, separately for input and output.
hooks.securityValue: Block hate, violence, and (critically) prompt-injection / jailbreak attempts (PROMPT_ATTACK) from reaching or leaving the model.
hooks.payload: { filtersConfig: [{ type, inputStrength, outputStrength, inputAction: BLOCK|NONE, outputAction }] }

hooks.name: Bedrock Denied Topics
hooks.description: topicPolicyConfig: block user-defined topics (NL definition + examples; up to 30 topics) from appearing in prompts or responses.
hooks.securityValue: Enforce domain restrictions: e.g. prevent a customer service agent from discussing competitors, legal advice, or out-of-scope subjects.
hooks.payload: { topicsConfig: [{ name, definition, examples, type: DENY, inputAction, outputAction }] }

hooks.name: Bedrock Word Filters
hooks.description: wordPolicyConfig: exact-match blocking of custom word lists plus a managed profanity list.
hooks.securityValue: Block specific competitor names, offensive terms, or proprietary strings from agent interactions.
hooks.payload: { wordsConfig: [{ text, inputAction, outputAction }], managedWordListsConfig: [{ type: PROFANITY }] }

hooks.name: Bedrock PII Filters
hooks.description: sensitiveInformationPolicyConfig: detect 40+ PII entity types (SSN, credit cards, AWS keys, passwords) plus custom regex; BLOCK or ANONYMIZE separately for input/output.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent PII exfiltration in responses; mask credentials in both directions; substitute {TYPE} placeholders.
hooks.payload: { piiEntitiesConfig: [{ type, inputAction: BLOCK|ANONYMIZE|NONE, outputAction }], regexesConfig: [{ name, pattern, inputAction, outputAction }] }

hooks.name: Bedrock Contextual Grounding
hooks.description: contextualGroundingPolicyConfig: score responses against a grounding source on GROUNDING (factual) and RELEVANCE axes; block below configurable threshold (0–0.99).
hooks.securityValue: Prevent hallucinated or off-topic responses in RAG agents; detect when the model invents facts not in the provided context.
hooks.payload: { filtersConfig: [{ type: GROUNDING|RELEVANCE, threshold: 0.7, action: BLOCK|NONE }] } + runtime grounding_source/query

hooks.name: Bedrock Automated Reasoning
hooks.description: automatedReasoningPolicyConfig: validates responses against formal-logic policies extracted from source documents. Detect-mode only: returns VALID/INVALID/TRANSLATION_AMBIGUOUS findings for the application to act on, does not auto-block.
hooks.securityValue: Detect factually-incorrect statements in compliance-critical domains (finance, HR, legal) via mathematical verification.

hooks.name: Vercel transformParams Middleware
hooks.description: LanguageModelV3Middleware.transformParams: wrap a language model with wrapLanguageModel(); transform request params (system prompt, messages, tools) before every doGenerate / doStream call.
hooks.securityValue: Inject security instructions, sanitize prompts, strip dangerous tool definitions before requests leave the application layer.

hooks.name: Vercel wrapGenerate Middleware
hooks.description: LanguageModelV3Middleware.wrapGenerate: wraps doGenerate end-to-end; choose not to call the wrapped function to short-circuit.
hooks.securityValue: Intercept and modify model results; implement output scanning, response caching, or block-and-substitute fallback.

hooks.name: Vercel wrapStream Middleware
hooks.description: LanguageModelV3Middleware.wrapStream: wraps doStream for streaming generation; per-chunk or full-stream transformation.
hooks.securityValue: Filter or redact streaming chunks before they reach the client; suppress policy-violating content in real time.

hooks.name: streamText.onChunk
hooks.description: streamText callback: fires for each chunk received (text, reasoning, tool-call, tool-call-delta, tool-result, source, file, start-step, finish-step, error).
hooks.securityValue: Detect policy-violating content as it streams; monitor tool-call chunks for dangerous invocations.

hooks.name: onStepFinish (Vercel AI SDK)
hooks.description: streamText/generateText callback: fires after each step in a multi-step (agentic) flow with finish reason, usage, tool calls, results.
hooks.securityValue: Audit each agent step; detect anomalous step patterns or excessive tool use in multi-step flows.
hooks.payload: (result: { stepType, finishReason, usage, text, toolCalls, toolResults, isContinued }) => Promise<void>

hooks.name: onFinish (Vercel AI SDK)
hooks.description: streamText/generateText callback: fires once when the entire generation completes with text, usage, all steps, and finish reason.
hooks.securityValue: Final output inspection for logging and compliance recording; detect content-filter terminations via finishReason.
hooks.payload: (result: { text, finishReason, usage, totalUsage, steps, toolCalls, toolResults, response }) => Promise<void>

hooks.name: onError (Vercel AI SDK)
hooks.description: streamText error handler: captures errors during streaming including content-filter rejections and API failures.
hooks.securityValue: Log content-filter rejections and detect systematic blocking patterns indicating abuse.

hooks.name: experimental_onToolCallStart / Finish
hooks.description: Beta callbacks on generateText/streamText: onToolCallStart fires before a tool's execute(); onToolCallFinish after with duration and error.
hooks.securityValue: Fine-grained tool telemetry; detect tools that fail or hang (potential network exfiltration indicators).
hooks.payload: { toolName, toolCallId, input } / { toolName, durationMs, error? }

hooks.name: Mastra processInput
hooks.description: Processor lifecycle method: runs once before the agentic loop begins. Call abort(reason) to halt; onViolation fires.
hooks.securityValue: Sanitize and validate all user inputs before the model; enforce allowed-topic lists, strip injection attempts.
hooks.payload: ({ messages, systemMessages, abort }) => Promise<MastraDBMessage[] | { messages, systemMessages }>

hooks.name: Mastra processInputStep
hooks.description: Processor: runs at each step of the agentic loop. Can reconfigure model or toolChoice dynamically.
hooks.securityValue: Enforce per-step policies: switch to a safer model after a suspicious step, or restrict tool choices based on context.
hooks.payload: ({ stepNumber, model, toolChoice, messageList, abort }) => Promise<...>

hooks.name: Mastra processLLMRequest
hooks.description: Processor that fires immediately before the provider API call. Rewrite the final prompt (transient, not persisted to history).
hooks.securityValue: Last-mile prompt sanitization; inject system-level security instructions without modifying visible conversation history.
hooks.payload: ({ prompt: CoreMessage[], model, stepNumber, steps, state, abort }) => Promise<CoreMessage[]>

hooks.name: Mastra processOutputStream
hooks.description: Processor: fires per streaming chunk. Return null to drop the chunk; call abort() to stop the entire stream.
hooks.securityValue: Filter or redact sensitive content from streaming responses in real time; suppress chunks containing credentials/PII.

hooks.name: Mastra processOutputStep
hooks.description: Processor: fires after each LLM step. abort({ retry: true, feedback }) re-runs the step with corrective instructions.
hooks.securityValue: Enforce output safety per step; trigger guided re-generation when responses violate policies.

hooks.name: Mastra processOutputResult
hooks.description: Processor: fires after the LLM generates its response but before returning. Final transformation point.
hooks.securityValue: Final compliance check before output reaches the user; enforce format or strip sensitive fields.

hooks.name: Mastra onViolation
hooks.description: Callback property: fires when abort() is called anywhere in the Processor pipeline. Errors thrown inside are silently caught.
hooks.securityValue: Centralized violation logging for all processor-level security events; feed to SIEM or alerting.

hooks.name: before_tool_execute (Pydantic AI)
hooks.description: @hooks.on.before_tool_execute: fires after model tool-call arguments are validated, immediately before the tool function runs. Raise SkipToolExecution(result) to substitute a result.
hooks.securityValue: Block dangerous tool calls (shell, file, network) based on arguments; redact PII from inputs; gate on policy.
hooks.payload: (ctx): ctx has tool name, args, RunContext

hooks.name: wrap tool_execute (Pydantic AI)
hooks.description: @hooks.on.tool_execute (wrap hook): wraps the entire tool execution. Must await the handler() to proceed.
hooks.securityValue: Sandbox tool invocations, swap arguments, sign/verify results.
hooks.payload: (ctx, *, handler: WrapToolExecuteHandler): must await handler() to proceed

hooks.name: before_tool_validate (Pydantic AI)
hooks.description: @hooks.on.before_tool_validate: fires before model-emitted JSON tool-call args are parsed/validated by Pydantic.
hooks.securityValue: Detect injection-driven malformed payloads or jailbreak markers in arg JSON before Pydantic parses them.
hooks.payload: (ctx): raise ModelRetry to force the model to re-emit

hooks.name: before_model_request (Pydantic AI)
hooks.description: @hooks.on.before_model_request: fires right before each LLM request is dispatched. Raise SkipModelRequest(response) to short-circuit.
hooks.securityValue: Inspect outgoing prompts for secrets/exfiltration; enforce model allowlist; add tenant headers.
hooks.payload: (ctx: RunContext, *, request_context: ModelRequestContext): raise SkipModelRequest(response) to short-circuit

hooks.name: Pydantic AI Run Hooks
hooks.description: @hooks.on.before_run / @hooks.on.run (wrap) / after_run / run_error: wrap the entire agent run lifecycle.
hooks.securityValue: Per-run audit logging, kill switch, output redaction at the outermost layer.
hooks.payload: (ctx, *, handler?): raise to abort; wrap variant must await handler() to proceed

hooks.name: prepare_tools (Pydantic AI)
hooks.description: @hooks.on.prepare_tools: per-step filter that receives the tool list and returns the filtered list. A separate prepare_output_tools hook exists for output tools.
hooks.securityValue: Hide privileged tools from the model based on context (don't expose delete_user to a low-trust session).

hooks.name: @agent.output_validator (Pydantic AI)
hooks.description: Decorator: runs after the model produces structured output, before returning. Raise ModelRetry to force regeneration.
hooks.securityValue: Validate output schema/content; force the model to retry when output violates policy.

hooks.name: ProcessHistory capability (Pydantic AI)
hooks.description: Agent(capabilities=[ProcessHistory(fn)]): runs before each model request; receives list[ModelMessage] and returns filtered list.
hooks.securityValue: Strip secrets, PII, or untrusted-source tool outputs from message history before re-sending to the model.
hooks.payload: (messages: list[ModelMessage]) -> list[ModelMessage] (sync or async; RunContext-aware variant)

hooks.name: DSPy on_module Callback
hooks.description: BaseCallback.on_module_start / on_module_end: fires when any dspy.Module subclass is invoked. Registered globally via dspy.configure(callbacks=[...]).
hooks.securityValue: Audit every program-level invocation; detect anomalous call patterns.
hooks.payload: on_module_start(call_id, instance, inputs) / on_module_end(call_id, outputs, exception)

hooks.name: DSPy on_lm Callback
hooks.description: BaseCallback.on_lm_start / on_lm_end: fires before/after dspy.LM (language model) calls.
hooks.securityValue: Inspect outgoing prompts; record/redact for forensics; PII detection.
hooks.payload: on_lm_start(call_id, instance, inputs) / on_lm_end(call_id, outputs, exception)

hooks.name: DSPy on_tool Callback
hooks.description: BaseCallback.on_tool_start / on_tool_end: fires when a dspy.Tool subclass is invoked.
hooks.securityValue: Per-tool audit log; correlate tool calls to specific module/run.

hooks.name: DSPy on_adapter Callback
hooks.description: BaseCallback.on_adapter_format_start/end and on_adapter_parse_start/end: fires when a dspy.Adapter formats the LM prompt or parses the LM output.
hooks.securityValue: Inspect/scrub the final serialized prompt; observe raw model output for prompt-injection markers before typed parsing.

hooks.name: smolagents step_callbacks
hooks.description: CodeAgent/MultiStepAgent kwarg: called at each ReAct step (Action, Planning, etc.). Supports list or dict mapping Type[MemoryStep] -> Callable. agent.interrupt() to abort.
hooks.securityValue: Inspect tool calls / generated code each step; interrupt the loop on policy violations.

hooks.name: smolagents final_answer_checks
hooks.description: Agent kwarg: validation functions run before accepting the agent's final answer. Returning False rejects the answer; agent must produce a new one.
hooks.securityValue: Refuse outputs containing leaked secrets, policy violations, or unsafe content; force regeneration.

hooks.name: smolagents planning_interval
hooks.description: Agent kwarg: forces a planning re-evaluation step every N action steps. Insertion point for plan auditing via step_callbacks.
hooks.securityValue: Periodic plan auditing; detect goal drift in long-running agent loops.

hooks.name: smolagents executor_type
hooks.description: CodeAgent kwarg: selects sandbox backend for executing model-generated Python code: "local" | "blaxel" | "e2b" | "modal" | "docker" | "wasm".
hooks.securityValue: Run untrusted LLM-generated code in isolated environments instead of the host process.

hooks.name: smolagents authorized_imports
hooks.description: CodeAgent kwarg additional_authorized_imports: import allowlist enforced by LocalPythonExecutor (AST-walking interpreter). Any import not on the list raises InterpreterError.
hooks.securityValue: Block os, subprocess, socket, etc.; prevent the LLM from importing dangerous modules.

hooks.name: Haystack confirmation_strategies
hooks.description: Agent(confirmation_strategies={tool_name: ConfirmationStrategy}): before any matched tool is invoked, control passes to the configured strategy (Always/Once/Never policies; Console UI implementations).
hooks.securityValue: Human-in-the-loop confirm/reject/modify of high-stakes tool calls (send_email, delete_record).

hooks.name: Haystack Pipeline Breakpoint
hooks.description: Pipeline.run(break_point=Breakpoint(component_name, visit_count, snapshot_file_path?)): raises BreakpointException with a full snapshot. AgentBreakpoint also available for LLM/ToolInvoker.
hooks.securityValue: Forensic pause at sensitive components; require external approval before resume.
hooks.payload: Breakpoint(component_name: str, visit_count: int = 0, snapshot_file_path?: str)

hooks.name: Haystack snapshot_callback
hooks.description: Pipeline.run / Agent.run kwarg: invoked when a PipelineSnapshot is created (at breakpoint or failure).
hooks.securityValue: Stream every pause/failure snapshot to a SIEM or forensic store instead of (or in addition to) disk.

hooks.name: Haystack Tracer Interface
hooks.description: tracing.enable_tracing(tracer): wraps every component execution with trace(operation_name, tags). Built-in: LoggingTracer, OpenTelemetry, Datadog. HAYSTACK_CONTENT_TRACING_ENABLED captures full I/O.
hooks.securityValue: Cross-component audit trail; full-content tracing for forensic and compliance use.

hooks.name: TerminalToolRule
hooks.description: Tool Rule: when the named tool is called, the agent loop terminates. send_message has this by default.
hooks.securityValue: Force the agent to halt after calling sensitive terminal tools (send_message, escalate_to_human).

hooks.name: InitToolRule
hooks.description: Tool Rule: constrains the agent's first tool call to be the named tool. Optionally with preset args.
hooks.securityValue: Force pre-flight checks (authn, policy lookup) as the mandatory first step of every run.

hooks.name: ChildToolRule
hooks.description: Tool Rule: after tool_name is called, only children tools are permitted next.
hooks.securityValue: Build safe tool-sequence graphs; block unrelated tool calls after a sensitive operation.

hooks.name: ConditionalToolRule
hooks.description: Tool Rule: after tool_name runs, next tool is selected based on its output value.
hooks.securityValue: Hard-code safe branch logic in policy rather than relying on model reasoning.

hooks.name: MaxCountPerStepToolRule
hooks.description: Tool Rule: hard cap on how many times a tool can be called per agent step.
hooks.securityValue: Mitigate denial-of-wallet / loop attacks against expensive or rate-limited tools.

hooks.name: ContinueToolRule
hooks.description: Tool Rule that marks the tool as non-terminal (force heartbeat). The agent must continue execution after calling it.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent premature termination; ensure mandatory follow-up after specific tools.

hooks.name: ParentToolRule
hooks.description: Tool Rule: child tools can only be invoked when the parent tool is in the current call graph.
hooks.securityValue: Restrict child-tool reachability; compose multi-step policy graphs.

hooks.name: RequiresApprovalToolRule
hooks.description: Tool Rule (ToolRuleType.requires_approval): the named tool cannot execute until a human approves the call. Defined in letta/schemas/tool_rule.py.
hooks.securityValue: Human-in-the-loop gate for high-stakes tools; pauses the agent until an operator approves the proposed invocation.

hooks.name: Letta E2B Sandbox
hooks.description: Setting E2B_API_KEY and E2B_SANDBOX_TEMPLATE_ID forces all user-defined custom tools to execute inside an E2B sandbox rather than the Letta server process. Does not sandbox MCP tools or built-in tools (e.g. memory_insert).
hooks.securityValue: Isolate untrusted tool code from server filesystem/network/secrets.

hooks.name: Agno pre_hooks
hooks.description: Agent(pre_hooks=[...]): runs after the session loads, before model context preparation. Raise InputCheckError(CheckTrigger) to block.
hooks.securityValue: Input-side guardrails: PII scrub, prompt-injection detection, jailbreak filtering.
hooks.payload: (run_input, agent, session, run_context, debug_mode): raise InputCheckError to block

hooks.name: Agno post_hooks
hooks.description: Agent(post_hooks=[...]): runs after the Agent/Team generates a response, before returning. Raise OutputCheckError to block.
hooks.securityValue: Output-side validation: factual checks, regulated-content compliance, tone, leaked-secret detection.

hooks.name: Agno Built-in Guardrails
hooks.description: Three built-in guardrail classes: PIIDetectionGuardrail, PromptInjectionGuardrail, OpenAIModerationGuardrail: attached via pre_hooks=[...]. Extend BaseGuardrail with check()/async_check() raising InputCheckError.
hooks.securityValue: Off-the-shelf defenses for the highest-frequency attack vectors (PII leakage, prompt injection).
hooks.payload: BaseGuardrail subclass; check(run_input) raises InputCheckError on violation

hooks.name: Agno tool_hooks
hooks.description: Agent(tool_hooks=[...]) and @tool(tool_hooks=[...]): wraps every tool invocation; the hook receives function_call and must invoke it to proceed.
hooks.securityValue: Per-tool authz / confirm / log; deny by raising or by not calling function_call(**arguments).

hooks.name: Agno per-tool pre_hook / post_hook
hooks.description: @tool(pre_hook=..., post_hook=...): fine-grained per-function variants. pre_hook can raise to deny.
hooks.securityValue: Per-function input/output validation without affecting other tools.

hooks.name: Continue Rules
hooks.description: .continue/rules/*.md with YAML frontmatter: name, globs, regex, alwaysApply, description. Rules are injected into the system prompt.
hooks.securityValue: Standing instructions to mitigate goal hijacking and enforce coding/security policy. Prompt-level guard: not a runtime intercept.
hooks.payload: { name, globs?, regex?, alwaysApply: bool, description }

hooks.name: Continue MCP Servers
hooks.description: .continue/mcpServers/*.yaml: declarative YAML files defining MCP servers the agent may use (name, command, args, env, type).
hooks.securityValue: Tool-surface reduction; only listed MCP servers contribute tools to the agent.

hooks.name: Continue Context Providers
hooks.description: config.yaml context[]: named providers (file, codebase, docs, url, diff, etc.) invoked via @ mentions; read-only data supply.
hooks.securityValue: Control what data sources the agent can pull into context via explicit provider list.

hooks.name: Continue Prompts
hooks.description: .continue/prompts/*.prompt files invoked via /name: replaces the deprecated customCommands.
hooks.securityValue: Standardize agent invocations to vetted prompt templates rather than ad-hoc instructions.

hooks.name: Continue Mission Control
hooks.description: Cloud control plane (hub.continue.dev): Tasks, Cloud Agents, Workflows, Inbox, and org-level component sharing. Visibility: Personal | Public | Organization.
hooks.securityValue: Centralized governance of agent configurations across an organization; admins can audit member configs.

hooks.name: GOOSE_MODE
hooks.description: Env var / config.yaml: values: "chat" (no tools), "approve" (per-call), "smart_approve" (LLM classifier), "auto" (default; no prompts).
hooks.securityValue: Session-wide execution gate. chat blocks all tools; approve requires confirmation for every call.

hooks.name: Goose Per-tool Permissions
hooks.description: ~/.config/goose/permission.yaml: always_allow[], ask_before[], never_allow[] per tool. Persists across sessions.
hooks.securityValue: Granular tool-level allow/deny; deny lists block destructive tools outright.

hooks.name: GOOSE_ALLOWLIST
hooks.description: Env var pointing to a YAML allowlist URL of approved extensions. Unlisted extensions blocked from installation.
hooks.securityValue: Supply-chain control: admins distribute a single allowlist URL to prevent installation of rogue extensions.

hooks.name: GOOSE_MAX_TURNS
hooks.description: Env var / config.yaml: halts the autonomous loop after N turns without user input.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent runaway agentic loops and bound cost / blast radius of rogue behavior.

hooks.name: OpenHands pre_tool_use
hooks.description: .openhands/hooks.json: shell command executed before any tool runs. stdin receives { event_type, tool_name, tool_input, session_id, working_dir }. Exit code 2 or { decision: "deny" } blocks.
hooks.securityValue: Block dangerous tool calls (destructive shell, sensitive writes, unauthorized MCP) before execution. Format matches Claude Code hooks.
hooks.payload: { event_type, tool_name, tool_input, session_id, working_dir }: env: OPENHANDS_EVENT_TYPE, OPENHANDS_TOOL_NAME

hooks.name: OpenHands post_tool_use
hooks.description: .openhands/hooks.json: shell command executed after any tool completes. stdin adds tool_response.
hooks.securityValue: Log all tool invocations with outputs; detect sensitive data in tool results; trigger external validation.

hooks.name: OpenHands user_prompt_submit
hooks.description: .openhands/hooks.json: fires after user submits a prompt, before LLM processes it. stdin includes the message text.
hooks.securityValue: Block prompts before they reach the model; detect prompt injection and enforce topic restrictions.

hooks.name: OpenHands stop
hooks.description: .openhands/hooks.json: fires when the agent tries to finish. Exit code 2 forces the agent to keep working (e.g. require lint to pass before stopping).
hooks.securityValue: Quality / safety gate at session completion; enforce required validation before work is accepted.

hooks.name: OpenHands session_start / session_end
hooks.description: .openhands/hooks.json: informational lifecycle hooks (async recommended).
hooks.securityValue: Initialize audit context at session start; finalize logs and telemetry at session end.

hooks.name: OpenHands Docker Runtime
hooks.description: SANDBOX_BASE_CONTAINER_IMAGE and SANDBOX_VOLUMES: every session runs in a Docker container. SANDBOX_RUNTIME_STARTUP_ENV_VARS forwards startup env into the sandbox.
hooks.securityValue: OS-level containment: agent actions are isolated from the host filesystem/network.

hooks.name: Roo Auto-Approve Toggles
hooks.description: Per-permission toggles in VS Code settings: read files, edit files, execute commands, browser, MCP tools, mode switch, subtasks. Off = requires approval.
hooks.securityValue: Granular approval gates: disable auto-approve for sensitive categories like shell or MCP.
hooks.payload: { alwaysAllowReadOnly, alwaysAllowWrite, alwaysAllowExecute, alwaysAllowBrowser, alwaysAllowMcp, alwaysAllowModeSwitch, alwaysAllowSubtasks: bool }

hooks.name: Roo allowedCommands / deniedCommands
hooks.description: VS Code settings: string arrays of command prefixes; longest-prefix wins, and deny beats allow when equally or more specific.
hooks.securityValue: Block destructive shell commands by prefix; allowlist safe operations.

hooks.name: Roo Custom Modes (fileRegex)
hooks.description: Per-mode tool group scoping with fileRegex in .roomodes or settings. FileRestrictionError thrown when the agent edits files not matching the mode's regex.
hooks.securityValue: Restrict which files an agent in a given mode may edit (e.g. docs-only mode limited to .md files).

hooks.name: .rooignore
hooks.description: Workspace .gitignore-syntax file. read_file, write_to_file, apply_diff, directory listing all blocked for matched paths.
hooks.securityValue: Hard-deny access to sensitive paths (.env, secrets/, prod configs): agent receives explicit error.

hooks.name: Roo Boomerang Subtask Approval
hooks.description: Orchestrator mode toggle "Always approve creation & completion of subtasks": by default, subtask creation and completion require approval.
hooks.securityValue: Human-in-the-loop gate on subagent spawn; control multi-agent decomposition.

hooks.name: Roo MCP Always Allow
hooks.description: Two-factor approval: global MCP toggle AND per-tool checkbox both required for auto-approval.
hooks.securityValue: Double-gate on MCP tool execution prevents accidental org-wide auto-approve of risky third-party tools.

hooks.name: Codex approval_policy
hooks.description: CLI flag --ask-for-approval or config.toml approval_policy: "untrusted" | "on-request" | "never".
hooks.securityValue: untrusted blocks all non-trusted commands pending approval; on-request blocks sandbox escalations.

hooks.name: Codex sandbox_mode
hooks.description: OS-enforced sandbox via sandbox-exec (macOS) or bwrap+seccomp (Linux). Values: "read-only" | "workspace-write" | "danger-full-access". writable_roots[] grants granular writes.
hooks.securityValue: Kernel-level execution containment, not just a config flag.

hooks.name: Codex Network Allowlist
hooks.description: features.network_proxy.domains map of patterns -> allow/deny (opt-in; off by default). DNS lookups that fail or resolve to private IPs are blocked.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent DNS rebinding, private-IP escalation, and unauthorized data exfiltration to attacker-controlled domains.

hooks.name: Codex approvals_reviewer
hooks.description: config approvals_reviewer: "user" | "auto_review". auto_review routes eligible approval requests through an autonomous reviewer agent (data-exfiltration / credential-probing patterns).
hooks.securityValue: Off-load approval triage to a dedicated reviewer agent; reduce user fatigue while still catching dangerous patterns.

hooks.name: Codex Hooks System
hooks.description: Programmatic hooks for events: SessionStart, SubagentStart, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, UserPromptSubmit, SubagentStop, Stop. Configured via ~/.codex/hooks.json, repo .codex/hooks.json, config.toml [hooks], or plugin manifests. Review-and-trust required; --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust opts out per-invocation. Similar exit-code contract to Claude Code (exit 2 = block).
hooks.securityValue: Full lifecycle interception comparable to Claude Code hooks; same exit-code contract.

hooks.name: Gemini CLI Approval Mode
hooks.description: settings.json general.defaultApprovalMode: values: "default" (prompt every tool call), "auto_edit" (edit tools auto-approved), "plan" (read-only). "yolo" (auto-approve all) is CLI-only via --yolo / --approval-mode=yolo.
hooks.securityValue: Session-wide gate. default blocks every tool pending confirmation.
hooks.payload: { general: { defaultApprovalMode: "default"|"auto_edit"|"plan" } }: yolo: CLI flag only

hooks.name: Gemini tools.core
hooks.description: settings.json tools.core[]: strict built-in tools allowlist (most restrictive pattern; bare names block any unlisted tool).
hooks.securityValue: Eliminate the implicit-tool surface; only whitelisted tools are available to the agent.

hooks.name: Gemini tools.allowed
hooks.description: settings.json tools.allowed[]: tools that bypass per-call confirmation dialogs. Supports per-arg patterns (e.g. "run_shell_command(git status)").
hooks.securityValue: Pre-approve safe operations while keeping default approval gating for everything else.

hooks.name: Gemini MCP Allowlist
hooks.description: settings.json mcp.allowed[] / mcp.excluded[] plus per-server includeTools[] / excludeTools[]. excludeTools beats includeTools; merges form an intersection (most restrictive wins).
hooks.securityValue: Strong supply-chain control over MCP: both server-level and tool-level allowlist/denylist with safe merge semantics.
hooks.payload: { mcp: { allowed[], excluded[] }, mcpServers: { name: { includeTools[], excludeTools[], trust } } }

hooks.name: Gemini mcpServers.trust
hooks.description: Per-server trust flag: trusted servers bypass per-call confirmation.
hooks.securityValue: Reduce friction for vetted MCP servers; keep full prompting for untrusted ones.

hooks.name: Gemini security.folderTrust
hooks.description: settings security.folderTrust.enabled: folder-trust gate before tools run on the project.
hooks.securityValue: Prevent the agent from operating on untrusted folders without explicit user trust.

hooks.name: Gemini Policy Engine
hooks.description: Five-tier policy precedence: Default -> Extension -> Workspace -> User -> Admin. Rules match on tool name, args (regex), execution environment, approval mode. Decisions: allow, deny, ask_user.
hooks.securityValue: Centralized, hierarchical authorization for tool execution; admin tier cannot be overridden.
hooks.payload: [[rule]] { toolName, argsPattern (regex), interactive, modes[], subagent?, mcpName?, decision: "allow"|"deny"|"ask_user" }

hooks.name: Gemini Enterprise System Override
hooks.description: Admin-deployed system file (Linux /etc/gemini-cli/settings.json, macOS /Library/Application Support/GeminiCli/settings.json, Windows C:\ProgramData\gemini-cli\settings.json): highest precedence, cannot be overridden by users.
hooks.securityValue: Org-wide policy enforcement at the OS-config layer; locks tool allowlists, sandbox, auth, MCP.

hooks.name: Amp tool.call plugin hook
hooks.description: amp.on('tool.call', handler) in .amp/plugins/*.ts: handler returns { action: 'allow' | 'reject-and-continue' | 'modify' | 'synthesize' | 'error', message? }.
hooks.securityValue: Programmatic pre-tool gate with five action modes (allow, reject-and-continue, modify, synthesize, error).

hooks.name: Amp tool.result plugin hook
hooks.description: amp.on('tool.result', handler): observe or modify tool output before model consumes it.
hooks.securityValue: Scrub sensitive output before it reaches model context; audit results.
hooks.payload: { toolUseID, tool, input, status, error?, output }

hooks.name: Amp agent.start plugin hook
hooks.description: amp.on('agent.start', handler): fires at turn start. Can append additional context with display: true.
hooks.securityValue: Inject security/policy context at the start of every agent turn.

hooks.name: Amp Guarded Files
hooks.description: amp.guardedFiles.allowlist[] (legacy; superseded by plugin-based permissions). Agent access blocked for non-allowlisted files. amp.dangerouslyAllowAll overrides.
hooks.securityValue: Lock agent file access to a known-safe set; ideal for protecting secrets/ directories.

hooks.name: Amp tools.disable
hooks.description: amp.tools.disable[]: disable specific tools by name or glob. Syntax 'builtin:name' targets only builtin tools.
hooks.securityValue: Surgical removal of dangerous tools from the agent surface.

hooks.name: Amp mcpPermissions
hooks.description: amp.mcpPermissions: array of pattern-matching rules on MCP command/args/url. First-match-wins with allow/reject.
hooks.securityValue: Fine-grained MCP filtering: block specific commands/URLs per MCP server.
hooks.payload: { mcpPermissions: [{ matches: { command?, args?, url? }, action: "allow"|"reject" }] }

hooks.name: Amp Secret Redaction
hooks.description: Automatic detection and redaction of secrets (AWS, GCP, Azure, GitHub, GitLab, OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, Slack, HuggingFace, npm, Sourcegraph): replaced with [REDACTED:<secret-type>] markers (e.g. [REDACTED:aws-access-key-id]) before the LLM sees them. Best-effort.
hooks.securityValue: Built-in protection against credential exfiltration via prompt or tool input/output.

hooks.name: Amp Managed Settings
hooks.description: Admin-deployed file: enforced globally and cannot be overridden by users. Paths: macOS /Library/Application Support/ampcode/managed-settings.json, Linux /etc/ampcode/managed-settings.json, Windows %ProgramData%\ampcode\managed-settings.json.
hooks.securityValue: Enterprise-grade lockdown of amp.* settings: permissions, guarded files, MCP, secret redaction.

hooks.name: idea_mcp_allowed_tools
hooks.description: ACP setting in JetBrains AI Assistant: when use_idea_mcp is true, restricts which tools from the integrated MCP server are exposed to external ACP agents.
hooks.securityValue: Limit IDE-exposed tools available to third-party ACP agents (Claude, Codex) via JetBrains.

hooks.name: JetBrains MCP Forwarding Toggles
hooks.description: Settings > Tools > AI Assistant > Agents: "Pass custom MCP servers" and "Pass IntelliJ MCP server" toggles for ACP forwarding. use_custom_mcp (default true) and use_idea_mcp (default false) in acp.json.
hooks.securityValue: Control which MCP tools and servers are exposed across the IDE to integrated agents.
hooks.payload: { use_custom_mcp: bool, use_idea_mcp: bool, idea_mcp_allowed_tools?: string[] }

hooks.name: Zed tool_permissions.default
hooks.description: settings.json agent.tool_permissions.default: "confirm" | "allow" | "deny": global fallback for all tools (per-tool override via tools.<tool>.default).
hooks.securityValue: Set the safe baseline: deny blocks every tool until explicitly allowed.

hooks.name: Zed always_deny patterns
hooks.description: Per-tool Rust-regex array always_deny[]: case-insensitive matches against command/path/URL; priority 2 (after hardcoded rm -rf protection).
hooks.securityValue: Block specific dangerous command/path patterns even when default is allow.

hooks.name: Zed always_allow patterns
hooks.description: Per-tool regex array: auto-approves matching inputs (priority 4).
hooks.securityValue: Pre-approve known-safe operations to reduce confirmation fatigue without losing per-call review for the rest.

hooks.name: Zed always_confirm patterns
hooks.description: Per-tool regex array: forces manual confirmation even when global default is allow (priority 3). Soft gate: review without block.
hooks.securityValue: Mandatory human review for sensitive patterns (e.g. writes to .env, force pushes) without outright blocking.

hooks.name: Zed Hardcoded rm -rf Protection
hooks.description: Built-in un-bypassable Rust regex rules block 'rm -rf /', '~', '.', '..', '$HOME' and variants: applied to all chained shell commands (priority 1, beats all config).
hooks.securityValue: Backstop against catastrophic data loss: cannot be disabled by config, applies even with auto-approve on.

hooks.name: Zed MCP Tool Permission Format
hooks.description: Per-tool MCP permission addressed as mcp:<server>:<tool> in the same agent.tool_permissions schema. Supports default permission levels (confirm/allow/deny).
hooks.securityValue: Per-server/per-tool MCP allow/deny in the same Zed permission system.
